source.name: NBA Stats CommonAllPlayers
source.coverageClaim: Every row returned by NBA CommonAllPlayers with current-only disabled; independent universal historical completeness is not asserted.

fieldConventions.season: YYYY-YY; no invented rows for inactive seasons or non-qualified playoffs
fieldConventions.totals: Exact selected source totals; unavailable fields null, not zero.
fieldConventions.percentages: Displayed source percentages normalized to fraction 0..1. A blank percentage after zero attempts remains null.
fieldConventions.perGame: Displayed source per-game values, rounded as published.
fieldConventions.GS: Not supplied by selected source tables, always null.
fieldConventions.PLUS_MINUS: Not supplied for these historical seasons, always null.
fieldConventions.eraAvailability: Source tables record STL/BLK/OREB/DREB from 1973-74, TOV from 1977-78, and FG3M/FG3A from 1979-80. Earlier values remain null.
fieldConventions.careerCoverage: Totals from partial eras are labeled with covered seasons and games. Never divide covered-era counts by all career games.
